newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta shares gain 18.8 points in weekly trading.
newsitem.headline: Malta shares gain 18.8 points in weekly trading.

text.p: The Malta stock exchange share index gained 18.8 points in its once weekly trading session on Wednesday, fuelled by gains in the shares of all the listed banks.
Total turnover on Wednesday reached 2.2 million Malta pounds ($5.6 million), up slightly from two million pounds the previous week.
Just under 698,000 shares having a total market value of 862,452 pounds were traded on Wednesday.
The heaviest trading was in Middle Sea Insurance where 645,370 shares changed hands in three deals at an average 123.7c, down 0.3 cents from the previous week.
In Bank of Valletta 44,697 shares were sold in 50 deals for an average 147.2 cents, up 6.1 cents.

Mid-Med Bank shares gained an average 6.3 cents, with 1,900 shares selling in six deals for 179.8 cents. Lombard Bank Malta shares gained four cents, with 1,400 selling in three deals for an average 167 cents each.
The average price of soft drinks maker Simonds Farsons Cisk ordinary shares lost 1.7 cents, with 3,198 shares selling in three deals for 47.1 cents.

Farsons 8.5 percent preference shares gained one cent, with 1,080 shares selling in four deals for an average 97 cents but Farsons six percent preference shares (nominal value 10 pounds) dropped 10 cents, with 100 shares selling for 999 cents.
Trading in government bonds saw turnover of nearly 1.4 million pounds with 17 securities dealt in 45 deals.
